titles.romaji: Xi Yangyang Yu Hui Tailang: Yangyang Yungdong Hui
titles.native: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之羊羊运动会

description: Goats from various tribes gather together on the Green-Green Grassland to participate in the magnificent 125th Goats Sports Games. There are many strong competitors such as the Argali, the speedy Tibetan antelopes, and the flexible robot goats. Events like shooting, aquatics and Ping-Pong all took place and challenged the competitors. Knowing that whoever wins the games could become the leader of the goats, Wolffy and his wife disguised as goats to take part. Who will be the final winner?
